lessons: Blocks between 5-9 cm may move if aligned closely or within 8 cm proximity; stability increases with greater distances and misalignment.
Blocks over 20 cm tend to remain stable unless within 10 cm proximity.
Stability decreases sharply under 10 cm proximity regardless of distance along the path.
Blocks between 10-25 cm may move if aligned closely or within 9 cm proximity; stability increases with greater distances and misalignment.
